Bug report from the order desk: on the order list screen, the footer says "Page 1 of 2" when there are 45 orders at 20 per page, so the last 5 orders can never be reached. It should say "Page 1 of 3": a last page that is only partly full still counts as a page. An empty list stays at 0 pages, as it is today.

Fix it in the `shopkit` package. Everything else must keep working as it does now. In particular the outbox (`shopkit/outbox.py`) must keep sending only full batches and holding the leftover messages for the next run, and bad page sizes must still raise ValueError. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -q` when you are done.
